lines: A pincer attack from the front and back.
Furthermore, on the face of it, Saitou was not carrying a weapon.
These people probably had absolute confidence in themselves.
All of a sudden, two new arms grew out of his back.
Combined with the arms that had been there from the beginning, there came to be four in total.
「It's like the investigation showed. Don't let your guards down!」
It seemed that they had investigated him to some extent.
However, they were blatantly taken aback, seeing his four arms.
Without flinching at all, Saitou casually swung his four arms in between the herde.

For the head: the top of the skull, the bridge of the nose, below the eyes, the upper lip, and the chin. For the torso: the cavity between the collarbones, the windpipe, the solar plexus, the liver meridian, and the ribs below the pectorals.
And apart from those, there were easily over fifty other vital points in the human body.
If he attacked just four of those at the same time, making natural use of the martial arts he had mastered, then a mere human being would easily collapse in agony.
All three assassins were lying around on the ground and moaning, fitting for their lowly status.
It would be easy to kill them, but dealing with the aftermath would be a pain. Besides, there was no value in that.
「Get lost. You're not even worth getting my noble hands dirty.」
Saitou turned his face to the entrance of the back alley.
He hadn't been addressing the Cabinet Intelligence assassins.
He was talking to the man who was observing him from the shadows.
「Yo. That was an impressive Anti-Demon Killer Move.」
The man who was hiding, Igawa Kageomi, showed himself.
「These guys are pathetic. Thanks to them, I didn't even get to eat half that stuff.」
「It's a term for a group of slaves like you.」
The two of them had squared off again.
